'''Suzy Myers''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Myers first began to provide voices for {{aniseries|PTS}} in [[Pokémon Chronicles]]. As with most other voice actors who worked with [[4Kids Entertainment]], she left when {{TPCi|Pokémon USA}} and [[TAJ Productions]] [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|took over the dubbing and distribution of the series]]. Later, she provided the voice of [[Normajean]] in ''[[DP190|The Brockster Is In!]]'', making her the final former 4Kids voice actor to return to the {{pkmn|animated series}} in {{aniseries|DP}}. In {{aniseries|XY}}, she gained two important roles, voicing the Kalos [[Pokédex]] and [[Clemont's Chespin]].
